criteria.criterion: Knowledge Wiki is the primary operator language while historical paths and the legacy command remain explicit compatibility surfaces.
The dated source encounter records access state, evidence class, contradictions, limitations, librarian requests, and separate publication authority.
The DCLA formation chronology distinguishes contemporaneous records, later recollection, press corroboration, and anti-claims.
The DCLA photograph is governed as both one exact occurrence and one member of a multi-frame scene cluster.
The Council source return distinguishes visible scene, later oral history, contemporary event corroboration, and unresolved outcomes while using the stronger bounded caption.
The KC Town Hall oral histories preserve people, craft, field practice, and collective credit while keeping two photographs held for human review.
Two public-safe proposal excerpts are checksum-bound and projected as useful artifacts with implementation and privacy boundaries intact.
No private locator, account address, phone number, person tag, raw transcript, or sensitive proposal field enters the public repository.
The KC Town Hall page names Jamie's independently supported role and concrete artifacts without understating him or claiming uncorroborated titles and outcomes.
Missing audio, rights, consent, exact credit, production, and indexing remain active questions rather than erased absences or machine-cleared gates.

hard_gates: Research authorization does not confer publication permission.
No raw correspondence, transcript, private path, private account address, phone number, source-system identifier, or participant list enters public Git.
No remembered photographer attribution becomes a public credit before confirmation.
No held construction portrait becomes a public asset before creator and represented-person review.
No proposal excerpt includes financial, banking, signature, applicant, contact, or resident-response material.
Machine pass does not approve staging, production, or indexing.
